tools.name: siro_resources
tools.description: Lists Siro's pay-per-call resources (67 in total) with id, name, category, USD price and a one-line summary. Use it first to find the right resource id; then read its input schema with siro_resource_schema and run it with siro_call. Categories: LLMs, image generation, audio (speech and transcription

tools.name: siro_resource_schema
tools.description: Returns everything needed to call one Siro resource: its USD price, the JSON Schema of its input, a ready-to-use example input, what it returns, and its HTTP endpoint. Use it after siro_resources and before siro_call so the input is valid (invalid input is rejected before any payment). Free, no paym

tools.name: siro_call
tools.description: Runs one Siro resource and pays its exact USD price over x402, in USDG on Robinhood Chain or USDC on Solana, Base, Arbitrum or Polygon. Send a signed x402 v2 PaymentPayload in params._meta["x402/payment"]; without it the tool returns isError with the payment requirements (price, networks, payTo) to

tools.name: siro_discover
tools.description: Searches for paid x402 APIs outside Siro's own catalog: tools other sellers list on Siro, featured partners, then the open x402 Bazaar index (run by Coinbase CDP), for needs such as weather, web search, data enrichment or token prices. Returns each service's URL, HTTP method, price, accepted network

tools.name: siro_tokens
tools.description: Lists the tokens a Siro wallet can swap through the KyberSwap aggregator on one network, with symbol, name and contract address. findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: siro_discover · Private data: siro_call, siro_discover, siro_tokens · Public sink: siro_call · Destructive: siro_resources, siro_discover.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: siro_discover · Private data: siro_call, siro_discover, siro_tokens · Public sink: siro_call · Destructive: siro_resources, siro_discover

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "siro_discover" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

evidence.snippet: before: "Searches the open x402 Bazaar index (run by Coinbase CDP) for paid APIs outside Siro's own catalog, such as weather, web search, data enrichment or token prices. Returns each service's URL, HTTP method, price, accepted networks, an example input and whether Siro can pay it (payable = accepts USDG on" → after: "Searches for paid x402 APIs outside Siro's own catalog: tools other sellers list on Siro, featured partners, then the open x402 Bazaar index (run by Coinbase CDP), for needs such as weather, web search, data enrichment or token prices. Returns each service's URL, HTTP method, price, accepted network"

findings.remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.
